headline: Good morning — Wall Street's AI-driven rout dragged the ASX lower, a day after the RBA lifted the cash rate to 4.85%.

highlights.label: Wall Street rout
highlights.text: The Nasdaq fell 5.5% into correction on Thursday as AI and chip stocks were sold off after the US midterms.

highlights.label: RBA hike
highlights.text: The RBA raised the cash rate 0.25 points to 4.85% in a 6-3 split vote, its fifth rise this year.

highlights.label: Cyclone Murasu
highlights.text: Andhra Pradesh's preliminary cyclone loss estimate is Rs 1,918.55 crore, with Chief Minister Naidu touring affected districts today.

tip.title: Build a short strength snack
tip.body: Pick one simple bodyweight move, such as sit-to-stands from a chair or wall push-ups, and do two sets of eight to ten between meetings. Short, regular bursts of resistance work add up across a week and need no equipment or change of clothes. Move at a comfortable pace and stop if anything hurts.

quote.text: Well done is better than well said.
quote.author: Benjamin Franklin

items.title: Salesforce to buy Braze for about US$5.66 billion
items.summary: Salesforce announced on 20 October that it will acquire the customer engagement platform Braze, aiming to strengthen cross-channel personalisation inside Marketing Cloud. The deal is still pending, so current product and licensing arrangements are unchanged for now. This item is slightly older than 48 hours.

items.title: Chiefmartec weighs martech consolidation after Braze deal
items.summary: Analysis of how the Braze acquisition fits a wider consolidation trend in marketing infrastructure. It is useful context for teams reviewing their engagement-platform and CDP vendor mix.

items.title: Salesforce expands Agentforce Coworker to Teams, mobile and desktop
items.summary: The 4 November expansion adds Microsoft Teams, mobile and desktop access, reusable Skills and conversation history. Scheduled tasks and a Daily Digest are expected in December 2026.

items.title: HubSpot begins retiring Design Manager serverless functions
items.summary: HubSpot is phasing out Design Manager serverless functions and Node.js 20 for workflow custom code actions. Existing functions can be edited until 17 November, so affected teams should plan migrations.

items.title: Adobe Journey Optimizer adds token resolution for AEM Content Fragments
items.summary: A limited-availability update on 5 November lets personalisation tokens resolve directly in AEM Content Fragments. It should simplify building personalised content in journeys.

items.title: Salesforce signs deal to acquire voice AI firm Cresta
items.summary: Announced 2 November, the deal adds voice-first AI agents and real-time rep coaching to Service Cloud. Price was reportedly about US$2.7 billion, but Salesforce has not confirmed terms.

items.title: Cresta is Salesforce's third deal in about two weeks
items.summary: Salesforce Ben ties Cresta to the earlier Rune Technologies and Braze announcements, signalling an active acquisition streak. It matters for customers watching how Agentforce and Marketing Cloud capabilities will be packaged.

items.title: Forrester says Cresta fills a service-AI gap for Salesforce
items.summary: Forrester argues Salesforce lacked a credible conversation intelligence offering before this deal. The view is analyst opinion rather than a confirmed product plan.

items.title: Agentforce Coworker widens reach on 4 November
items.summary: Coworker now reaches Teams, mobile and desktop, with Field Service, Consumer Goods Cloud and Life Sciences Cloud mobile access expected in December 2026. It extends Agentforce into everyday workflow tools.

items.title: Salesforce confirms Braze purchase at roughly US$5.66 billion
items.summary: The October announcement says Braze's profiles and decisioning will complement Data 360 and Agentforce. It remains pending, and older than 48 hours.

sfstatus.statusNote: No Salesforce incidents or planned maintenance for the last 48 hours were found in search results; status.salesforce.com should be checked directly for AU instances.

items.title: RBA lifts cash rate to 4.85% in split vote
items.summary: The board raised rates by 0.25 points on Cup Day, its fifth hike this year, with six members in favour and three against. It takes the cash rate to its highest since 2008 and adds to mortgage pressure.

items.title: ASX slides as US tech rout hits local shares
items.summary: The ASX 200 was down about 0.8% to 8,993 mid-afternoon after Wall Street's AI sell-off. Separately, the live blog reports department store David Jones has entered administration.

items.title: Albanese calls alleged attack on MP Helen Haines a wake-up call
items.summary: The Prime Minister raised the alleged attack on the independent MP at the Commonwealth leaders' meeting. Haines was reportedly hit by a car on 19 October and remains in a serious condition.

items.title: Pressure over planned sale of Victoria Barracks
items.summary: Critics say the Prime Minister risks a large voter backlash unless Defence Minister Richard Marles reverses the sale of the Melbourne site. The date of the report is unclear, so it may be older than 48 hours.

items.title: No deal yet on UK traveller work rules
items.summary: Albanese did not secure agreement with Britain on longer regional work for backpackers. The trip coincided with the latest RBA rate rise.

items.title: Sensex surges about 2,000 points on 5 November
items.summary: The Sensex jumped 2,009 points and the Nifty closed at 24,537, adding about Rs 7 trillion to investor wealth. Trading was more mixed on 6 November.

items.title: Groww shares drop nearly 7% in Friday trade
items.summary: Early trade on 6 November was mixed, with the Nifty near 24,600 and Groww shares sharply lower. Dhanteras and Q2 results are also in focus.

items.title: Supreme Court issues notice to Election Commission over voter-roll revision
items.summary: A bench led by the Chief Justice issued notice on a petition by Rahul Gandhi and INDIA bloc leaders challenging the SIR voter-list process. Counter-affidavits are awaited. This coverage dates from mid-October.

items.title: Opposition marches to Supreme Court against election chief
items.summary: Opposition parties protested the removal of voters from rolls and demanded the Chief Election Commissioner's resignation. Heavy security was deployed in Delhi. Older than 48 hours.

items.title: Rahul Gandhi moves court over SIR irregularities
items.summary: Live coverage showed scuffles between protesters and police as the opposition pressed its voter-roll complaints. Older than 48 hours, as few fresh national stories surfaced.

items.title: Naidu puts preliminary cyclone loss at Rs 1,918.55 crore
items.summary: The Chief Minister said 983 houses and 346 boats were damaged by Cyclone Murasu. The figure is preliminary and may be revised.

items.title: Naidu to tour cyclone-hit Bapatla and Guntur today
items.summary: The Chief Minister planned to inspect drain damage and talk with farmers about crop losses on 6 November. It will shape relief decisions.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu reported to have killed eight
items.summary: The report puts deaths at eight, mostly in Bapatla district, with crop damage over 1.43 lakh hectares. Early reports gave lower figures, so numbers are not independently confirmed.

items.title: Early cyclone toll: two dead, 312 houses damaged
items.summary: An earlier assessment counted two deaths and 12,230 people moved to relief centres. Later reports show damage estimates rising.

items.title: Naidu orders faster restoration and readiness for another cyclone
items.summary: On 1 November the Chief Minister told officials to speed up restoration after Cyclone Arnab and prepare for another system. Slightly older than 48 hours.

items.title: Nasdaq falls into correction in worst day since April 2025
items.summary: The Dow dropped more than 1,800 points as chip and AI stocks were hit, with Nvidia down about 9%. Investors fear the Democratic midterm sweep could slow data-centre build-outs.

items.title: Dow plunges as AI trade melts down
items.summary: Live coverage described the selloff spreading across semiconductors and data-centre names. Weakness flowed into Asian markets on Friday.

items.title: What may move the market in Friday's session
items.summary: Traders are watching whether selling continues, with the US payrolls report due Friday. One report described US futures as mixed early.

items.title: ASX falls as US tech stocks plunge on AI pullback fears
items.summary: Materials, real estate, industrials and tech led losses, while Nine Entertainment rose over 6%. Figures are intraday, not the final close.

items.title: Five things to watch on the ASX 200 today
items.summary: A preview of the session as futures pointed to a weaker open. Thursday's rally of about 2.6% was partly reversed.

items.title: RBA hike keeps rates in focus for investors
items.summary: The Monetary Policy Board lifted the cash rate to 4.85% on 3 November in a 6-3 vote. Banks are passing on the rise, affecting savings and loan rates.

items.title: Auction clearance rate hits six-year low near 41%
items.summary: The capital-city weighted rate fell to 40.7%, the lowest since April 2020, with Melbourne at 44.3% and Brisbane at 23.8%. A Cup Day holiday weighed on activity.

items.title: Bloomberg reports auction clearances at six-year low
items.summary: Cotality counted 1,735 auctions across the capitals, 17.7% fewer than a year earlier. Higher interest rates are thinning buyer demand.

items.title: Home values fall 1.2% in October
items.summary: Cotality's index shows values 6.7% below the March peak, though still 3.7% up on a year earlier. This summary was published 2 November.

items.title: RBA raises cash rate to 4.85%
items.summary: The fifth increase of the year takes rates to an 18-year high, adding pressure on borrowers and the housing market.

items.title: Macquarie to lift variable home loan rates
items.summary: Macquarie is raising variable reference rates by 0.25% a year from 19 November. Other lenders are likely to pass on the rise.
